answers.core: This would affect the core Window implementation and therefore couldn't be a download from the asset library.
answers.workaround: The only way I can think of to work around this is to disable the `exclusive` flag and re-implement its functionality yourself, which would certainly be more than a few lines of script.

title: Allow `NOTIFICATION_WM_QUIT_REQUEST` to pass through to parent window when using exclusive embedded subwindow
